text.p: Scangraphics Inc said on Tuesday that Laurence Osterwise has been appointed chief operating officer and is expected to become chief executive officer after a transitional period.
The company said Osterwise was president of the communications division at General Instrument Corp and a former IBM Corp executive before joining Scangraphics.
Besides becoming chief operating officer, Osterwise has also been named president of Sedona GeoServices Inc, a Scangraphics subsidiary, Scangraphics said.
Osterwise is expected to succeed company founder and Chief Executive Andrew Trolio, 67, said company director Michael Mulshine.
Mulshine said the transitional period for Osterwise to become chief executive "could be anywhere from three to nine months."
